h1: Charisma Residence Rayong — spacious residence rooms on a budget, right on the main road near Passione
intro: Picture this: a room over thirty square metres wide, with a private balcony, some with a small kitchenette, parking right in front of the building — and the whole night still lands in the high hundreds to low thousands of baht, a ten-minute drive from Saeng Chan Beach. Charisma Residence, which locals in Rayong call "Charisma Residence," is an apartment/residence-style stay in the Noen Phra area, right on Sukhumvit Road, that suits people working near the industrial estates, budget travellers, and small families who want a roomy place at an easy price · what real reviews mention most is the value, the spacious clean rooms, the good water pressure and the easy parking · there are around 33 rooms, starting from around THB 700–1,400/night · average score around 8.6 from real reviews across several platforms

Another room layout at Charisma Residence with a fridge, flat-screen TV and a roomy seating corner
The exterior of Charisma Residence Rayong, a residence-style stay right on Sukhumvit Road in the Noen Phra area

body.html: Who Charisma Residence is right for — to put it as briefly as possible, Charisma Residence Rayong is a residence-style stay that plays the "value" game first and foremost · it is not a seaside resort that lulls you to sleep with the waves, and it is not a big-brand hotel with a plush lobby and a pool · it is a daily-rental building in the apartment/condo style, in the Noen Phra area, right on Sukhumvit Road in Mueang Rayong district · it has been open long enough to be a familiar name among budget travellers and people working in the area, and it still takes guests as usual today · real reviews agree that the people it suits best are business travellers, technicians or staff coming to work at the industrial estates around Map Ta Phut and the Eastern Seaboard for multi-night stays, couples or solo travellers who want a roomy room at a budget price, and small families driving to Rayong who want an affordable base · the group that may enjoy it less is people looking for full hotel-style facilities such as a pool, an in-house restaurant, or round-the-clock service across the board, because this is a residence that focuses on the rooms and basic functions more than anything · put simply, if room size, cleanliness, parking and price are your top priorities, this place delivers very well, but if you want full hotel facilities and service or a seaside atmosphere, you should look at a different type of stay instead

Location and getting around — the strength of Charisma Residence is being "right on the main road, easy to find, easy to drive to" · the building sits at 999 Moo 3, Sukhumvit Road, Noen Phra, Mueang Rayong, which is the main route connecting into town and out toward the various beaches with ease · several real reviews agree that it is easy to find because it is right on the main road, easy to get in and out, and has parking — which matters a lot for people driving themselves · in terms of destinations, the hotel is near Passione Shopping Destination and the Midtown area at around 0.8–1 km, a few minutes' drive to the city's dining and shopping · as for the sea that many people come to Rayong to visit, Saeng Chan Beach is about a 10 min drive away (around 2–4 km depending on the route), which suits staying in town at night and driving out to swim or eat seafood during the day · Mae Ramphueng Beach and the Ban Phe–Koh Samet side are a bit further out · for those flying in, U-Tapao Airport (UTP) is also within a short drive · one small note: because the stay is right on Sukhumvit Road where traffic runs constantly, rooms facing the road or on lower floors may hear some traffic at times, and if you mean to spend the whole trip mostly at the beach you will have to drive back and forth to the shore every day — the trade-off being a lower price and the convenience of restaurants in town

"The room is very spacious for the price, clean, good water pressure, and you can park easily right in front · easy to find because it's right on the main road, and Saeng Chan Beach is just ten minutes' drive. Great value for this budget."

Room types and decor — Charisma Residence has around 33 rooms, split into several tiers by size and function · from the booking information, the main rooms are Standard Double and Standard Twin, standard rooms for a couple or solo travellers · Deluxe, which steps up in both size and decor, with some rooms having a small in-room kitchenette (pantry) · and Suite, for those who want a bigger seating area or are coming as a group · most rooms are around 30–40 square metres, which is clearly more spacious than the hotel rooms at the same price point at many places in Rayong — this is what real reviews praise most · every room has air conditioning, a private balcony, a flat-screen TV, a fridge, a water heater and free drinking water, along with a private bathroom that many people praise for good water pressure · some rooms have a kitchenette with a microwave and basic cooking gear, which suits longer stays where you want to cook to save money · the decor is a simple, clean style in bright tones, kept up well, and many reviews say it looks newer and in better shape than expected at this price · to be straight about it, because this is a residence-style building, the soundproofing between rooms may not be as tight as a big hotel, so some reviews hear the neighbouring room a bit, and a few mention that the air conditioning in some rooms does not cool fully on very hot days · the advice from reviews is that if quiet matters to you, ask for a higher floor or a room not facing the road when booking

Facilities and common areas — you have to understand first that Charisma Residence is a residence-style stay, not a resort hotel, so the selling point is not a pool or a big garden but functions that are "necessary and genuinely usable" · the common areas have a fitness room, a lounge/shared seating space, a lift and balconies to use · what real reviews rate highly is the free private parking, which is spacious and convenient — very important for people driving themselves — along with 24-hour security, laundry service/coin-operated washers, luggage storage, and free Wi-Fi in all rooms · there is a private check-in/check-out and a front desk that speaks both Thai and English · the point to know is that the front desk may not be open a full 24 hours like a big hotel, and there is no proper in-house restaurant, so if you arrive late you should let them know your check-in time in advance · overall the facilities here are enough for a stay used as a base for sleeping and working, more than a destination where you spend all day in the building, which fits the price and concept of the stay

Food and eating nearby — Charisma Residence does not focus on an in-house dining room, and at times breakfast may be an option you pay extra for (around 150–400 baht depending on the package) rather than included in every room rate, so check the conditions clearly when booking · but the real charm of staying in this area is the location near Passione and Midtown, which bring restaurants, cafés and supermarkets within a few minutes' drive · around the hotel on Sukhumvit Road and in the Noen Phra area there are also plenty of local eateries, made-to-order shops and convenience stores to choose from · for those who book a room with a kitchenette, having a fridge, microwave and water heater in the room makes it easy to buy ingredients to cook or to reheat food, which saves money on longer stays · so many people use this as a place to sleep and work, eating out at the mall or at restaurants in town, and driving out for seafood by the sea for some meals · to be honest, food is not a direct strength of this stay, but the location near malls and restaurants makes up for it well, and it is an advantage of staying in town rather than by the beach where the choice of restaurants may be smaller

Service — service is another point that wins Charisma Residence over with guests, even though it is a small stay · several real reviews praise that the staff are friendly, take good care of you, and handle things smoothly — check-in/check-out, recommending restaurants and places to visit, and sorting out parking · being a small stay makes dealing with staff fairly casual, and it feels more like staying at a home than at a big hotel · to be straight about it, because it is a residence where the team is not large, some services may not be instant at all hours the way a hotel with several shifts of staff would be, and the front desk may have limited hours · if you have a special request, such as a quiet room, a late check-in, or laundry service, it is best to let them know in advance so the team can prepare in time · overall the service is a strength that fits the price and is why many guests say they would come back if they were working in or visiting Rayong

Voices from real reviews (praise and gripes) — gathered from Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com and Traveloka, the picture is fairly consistent · On the praise side: value and room size come first, with many saying "the room is very spacious for the price," the rooms are clean and look new, the water pressure is good, the parking is convenient and spacious, the location right on the main road is easy to find and easy to get in and out of, it is near the mall and a ten-minute drive to Saeng Chan Beach, and the staff are friendly and helpful · On the note side: what comes up often is the air conditioning in some rooms not cooling fully on very hot days · next is soundproofing between rooms not being very tight, sometimes hearing the neighbouring room or street noise in rooms facing the road · there are also notes about common facilities not being as complete as a hotel (no pool, no in-house restaurant) and the front desk not being open a full 24 hours · these gripes are about the type of stay and setting expectations more than problems that make people feel cheated on price, because most end with "worth what you pay"

"The room is clean and spacious, the parking is very easy, the staff are lovely · the only gripes are the air conditioning cooling slowly during very hot afternoons and hearing the room next door a bit, but for this price it's fine and I'd come back again if I'm working around here."

Price and value comparison — Charisma Residence's room rates can start very low relative to the room size you get · from the booking information, standard rooms start at around THB 700–900/night in normal periods, while the Deluxe rooms with a kitchenette and the Suite rooms are in the range of around THB 1,100–1,400/night · counting that you get a 30–40 square metre room with a balcony, a fridge, and a kitchenette in some rooms, this price is hard to find in Rayong · compared with in-town hotels like Rayong City Hotel, which starts in the low thousands but with a smaller room, or a newer-brand hotel like Holiday Inn & Suites, which starts several times higher, Charisma Residence gives a clear sense of value within the budget group that prioritises room space and parking · what you trade away is hotel-style common facilities (no pool, no in-house restaurant) and service that is not a full 24 hours · if you are a business traveller, a long-stay guest, or a family who weighs budget, room size and parking over luxury, every baht spent here is money well returned

Things to know before booking — there are several things that help make the stay smoother · one, check clearly whether the rate you book includes breakfast, because in some packages breakfast is an add-on (around 150–400 baht) and not included in every room · two, if you want a room with a kitchenette for cooking yourself or a long stay, specify a Deluxe room with a pantry when booking, because not every room has one · three, if you are a light sleeper and sensitive to noise, ask for a higher floor or a room not facing Sukhumvit Road, because the soundproofing is not tight and there is some traffic noise from the main road · four, if you arrive late, let them know your check-in time in advance, because the front desk may have limited hours and is not a full 24 hours · five, if you mean to come mainly for the beach, be prepared to drive back and forth to Saeng Chan Beach or another beach every day, or consider a beachfront resort instead · six, compare prices across several platforms — Agoda, Booking and Trip.com — before booking, because promotions often differ, and choose free cancellation if your plans are still uncertain

Summary — from all the real reviews, Charisma Residence Rayong is the stay that suits best for people who want a spacious, clean room in the high hundreds to low thousands of baht, in the middle of the Noen Phra area of Mueang Rayong, with convenient parking and a location right on the main road that is easy to find · a 30–40 square metre room with a balcony, some with a kitchenette, good water pressure, friendly staff, near Passione and a ten-minute drive to Saeng Chan Beach make it a well-rounded budget choice for business travellers, long-stay guests and families · but you have to accept honestly that this is a residence-style stay, with no pool or in-house restaurant, the air conditioning in some rooms not cooling fully, soundproofing between rooms not being very tight, and the front desk not open a full 24 hours · if you are looking for full hotel facilities or a seaside atmosphere, this may not be the answer, and you should consider an in-town hotel or a beachfront resort instead · but for a trip that weighs budget, room size and value above all — Charisma Residence answers the need for an affordable, spacious stay in the middle of Rayong honestly and with real value
